::: {.status-page}
[Subscription]{.kicker}

# One click to finish {#status-title .unnumbered .unlisted}

[Confirm below and you'll get an email whenever I publish something new.]{#status-text .lede}

```{=html}
<p><button id="confirm-button" class="btn-warm" type="button">Confirm my subscription</button></p>
<p id="back-link" hidden><a class="btn-warm ghost" href="index.html">Start reading</a></p>
<script>
(function () {
  var token = new URLSearchParams(location.search).get("token"),
      endpoint = document.body.dataset.subscribeEndpoint,
      btn = document.getElementById("confirm-button"), back = document.getElementById("back-link"),
      title = document.getElementById("status-title"), text = document.getElementById("status-text");
  if (!token || !endpoint) { btn.hidden = true; text.textContent = "This link is missing its code. Please use the button in your confirmation email."; return; }
  btn.addEventListener("click", function () {
    btn.disabled = true; btn.textContent = "Confirming…";
    fetch(endpoint + "/confirm", { method: "POST", headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" }, body: JSON.stringify({ token: token }) })
      .then(function (r) { return r.json(); })
      .then(function (d) {
        btn.hidden = true; back.hidden = false;
        title.textContent = d.ok ? "Thank you for subscribing" : "That link didn't work";
        text.textContent = d.ok ? "You're in. A welcome note is on its way, and you'll hear from me whenever something new is published."
                                : d.message;
      })
      .catch(function () { btn.disabled = false; btn.textContent = "Confirm my subscription"; text.textContent = "Couldn't reach the server. Please try again."; });
  });
})();
</script>
```
:::
